chapter: Hampton and Basie: tours and road life
title: Basie tours: command performances and the world
summary: Royal recalls playing for the Queen and Princess Margaret and touring Europe, Japan, South America and Africa with Basie.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Did the Queen seem to enjoy the music?

Oh, Margaret used to follow us all the time. She was quite a jazz fan. She -- you could always expect to see her when we were around. Of course, usually when we were there, for the amount of time, if a command performance was on, Basie Band was there, we were there with Judy Garland, this other guy, Italian singer, Enzo -- what was his name? (Singing) To be my love -- what's --

Anyway, he died. We traveled all over Western Europe. We didn't get behind the Iron Curtain, to Russia, while I was there. I don't think they ever went there. But we went to Japan, over in the Orient, and did just about everything. We went to South America and all the Caribbean, North Africa, did everything except Russia with the Basie Band. It was -- I actually went ______ with Basie to spend probably six months and ended up 20 years --
